booking.termsIntro: At MyTable, we place great importance on the protection of your personal data and respect for your privacy.
booking.dataUsageText: We collect and store only the information necessary to connect you with chefs and manage your reservations. This data includes your name, first name, email, phone number, and reservation details.
booking.dataProtectionText: Your data is stored securely and is never sold, shared, or used for commercial purposes by third parties. We use your information only to:
booking.dataUsageList1: Facilitate communication between you and chefs
booking.dataUsageList3: Send you confirmations and information related to your reservation
booking.yourRightsText: In accordance with GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, delete, and object to your personal data. To exercise these rights, you can contact us at any time.
booking.termsAcceptance: By accepting these terms, you confirm that you have read and understood our data protection policy.
